info.name: IMAP Multi-Domain Login
info.summary: IMAP authentication with per-domain group and quota assignment
info.description:
IMAP authentication backend that maps email domains to different IMAP servers.
Users who log in for the first time are created automatically, added to the configured Nextcloud groups and get a default quota. All settings are managed by administrators in the admin settings or via `occ`.
No other app is needed. Users of the app *External user authentication* (`user_external`) can be imported.
